notes.title: Devlog 02 - First Look Gameplay
notes.content:
Finally I can show you guys the gameplay !!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44551475/a7ffc5b386e8c201324734f13eae9bb1fb14bef4.gif[/img]

It's a bit empty, and need to lot of polish, sadly I need to focus on other things right now.
as I still need to add some other feature.
I'm not sure what I should share about for next devlog, but I've been working it everyday.
But it's probably another snapshot of the gameplay.

See you guys next year with the next update,
and Merry Christmas and happy New Year !!!

Hi guys,

I suppose to update the progress months ago and wrote some impactful log, but here I am.
After 175 days of development, finally I push myself to create a first dev update.
In summary, its 90% to reach alpha stage,
The progress run smoothly as scheduled, and probably released on the q4 2024,
And the gameplay teaser will be released on the coming weeks.

Thanks for reading, stay safe !!
